policySet.scope: Search burst, sustained arrival, outcome readiness, latency, and controlled provider amplification
policySet.owner: Lighthouse operational readiness and search runtime

collectorAuthority.scope: Locked exact-report transition tuples through the last retained non-publication compatibility tree, version-specific v4 count and v5 ordered-identity readiness normalization, immutable unavailable-measurement binding, guarded-tree negative guards, and controlled provider counters

coverage.lens: Q3 launch burst, sustained workload, and provider amplification
coverage.reason: The approved small-cohort launch envelope has locked u20 burst, sustained 1/s, and controlled provider-counter evidence.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Re-collect when the launch arrival model, search result meaning, provider path, latency budget, or topology profile changes.

coverage.reason: Two 2/s trials completed 119 of 120 journeys because of final provider timeouts; 2/s is not the approved small-cohort launch envelope.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Re-enter when observed demand or a Human capacity decision raises the sustained launch target above 1/s.

coverage.lens: Q3 production fleet overlap and provider-account hard cap
coverage.reason: Single-process local evidence cannot establish simultaneous production runtime count or a provider-account global hard cap.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Re-enter with exact production runtime-overlap telemetry or a provider-side allowance contract.

coverage.lens: Q3 production p99, 5xx, and database-pool behavior
coverage.reason: Local workload reports do not establish production p99, 5xx rate, or Supabase pool utilization.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Use the production trial and Operational Readiness rollout evidence before opening the launch cohort.

coverage.reason: Request counters are bound only for a controlled loopback provider; real Episteme measurements do not expose attributable counters.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Re-enter when Episteme supplies a fresh attributable counter window or equivalent trace identity.

coverage.reason: A workload verdict cannot decide whether the Q3 machinery costs more than the failures it prevents.
coverage.reentryTrigger: Audit unique findings, false positives, runtime, and maintenance volume at Q3 closeout; consolidate or delete low-value machinery.

policies.question: Does the approved small-cohort search workload complete with ready results inside its latency and controlled provider-amplification budgets?
policies.desired: The u20 burst and sustained 1/s workload return ready results with no error or shed inside 3 seconds p95; the controlled scenario uses at most two successful provider requests per completed journey.
verificationPlan: Bind locked clean reports for the approved burst, sustained, and controlled-provider scenarios; reject altered attribution, profiles, counts, counters, or relevant product-source drift.
